regime_context: China A-shares shows a single dominant narrative (Banks) with a narrow, absorbed rotation — only 2 of 22 themes are trend-eligible, breadth of rotation is 9%, and the backtest verdict says the absolute-trend gate did NOT reduce drawdown on this market's own history (gate_helps=false). Cross-sectional rank is a focus lens only, and the past 98 calls show direction accuracy of 0.337 — materially below coin-flip — so any directional lean here must be very low conviction and explicitly conditional.
emerging_watch: Watch for a confirmed leadership handoff from Banks to Coal: the observable condition that retires this watch is Coal's breadth rising above 0.5 while Banks' breadth falls below 0.5 on overlapping days (confirmed rotation, not a single-day cross).

theses.subject: Banks
theses.thesis: Banks is the only theme that is simultaneously (1) trend-eligible, (2) highest durability_bar (0.87, hurst_tag 'trend'), (3) broadest participation (breadth 0.944), and (4) the current rotation leader. This is a trend-CONTINUATION lean anchored on durability + the absolute-trend gate's eligibility signal, not on the momentum rank itself. Crowding_z=1.98 with one_narrative=true is a sizing caution only (per guardrails: cap, never fade).
evidence: crowded=true, crowding_z=1.98 (down-size caution, not a fade signal)
theses.dissent: The trend gate did_NOT_hold_here historically — this is a mean-reverting tape where whipsaws punish trend-following — and with direction accuracy 0.337 the upside call has no validated edge. A crowded one-narrative is historically where China A-share momentum themes get extended into a sharp unwind.

falsifier.text: 512800.SS (Banks ETF) trades below its 20-day rolling low before the check-by date

theses.subject: Coal
theses.thesis: Coal is the only second eligible theme and the rotation challenger, but its texture is weak for a trend-continuation: durability_bar=0.47 with hurst_tag='mean-revert' (not trend), and breadth=0.2 — only a fifth of constituents participating. The narrow-rotation structure means leadership has NOT broadened to Coal; it shows up on rank but not on trend-health. An underweight lean expresses the view that it is less likely to sustain leadership than Banks, not a fade call.
theses.dissent: Coal is the only other eligible trend candidate besides Banks, and if the crowded Banks narrative unwinds, mean-reverting Coal could be the first destination for rotation flow precisely because it is NOT crowded.

falsifier.text: 515220.SS (Coal ETF) closes above its 20-day rolling high and breadth expands above 0.5 before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
